fixtures.authored_by: live AppleScript automation against Microsoft Excel for Mac 16.108, confirmed genuine producer output (calcChain.xml, theme1.xml, xr:uid all present)

checks.formula_A3_note: Formula text 'A2*2' preserved; cached <v> in the saved file was stale (20, from before the edit) but Excel recalculated live on open to the correct 1110 -- this is normal Excel behavior for any tool that doesn't recompute cached values on save, not a defect. See CHANGELOG note below.

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_fixture.summary: WorkbookSheet (the struct backing the CLI/PyO3 load path) had no field for formula text at all -- every save silently flattened every untouched formula cell to its last cached value, with no <f> element.

xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels and _rels/.rels are both fully regenerated from a fixed template that only knew about worksheet/sharedStrings/styles/vbaProject/officeDocument -- xl/theme/theme1.xml and docProps/{app,core}.xml passed through byte-identical but lost their relationships, becoming orphaned parts.

workbook.xml's content type was chosen from whether a VBA project was actually present, not from the output file extension -- any .xlsm output with no VBA project (the common case for this fixture) declared the plain (non-macro) content type inside a .xlsm-named file. This was the dominant cause: Excel refused to open the file outright, not even a repair prompt, until fixed.
